title: Budget Narrative Attachment Form
notes: Proposed consolidation follows existing SGG 48d93f882c63a711bdec4b16e3150d1293cdff43 and the XSD Attachments/AttachedFile list (1–100): the DAT mandatory first-file control and optional-more-files control become one ordered attachments array. This records the 2-0 input explicitly; no document answer is omitted. Reviewer confirmation remains open.
Shared upload transport does not make project narrative, budget narrative and other attachments the same question or reusable answer. Preserve each form’s purpose and agency instructions.

Existing SGG baseline: https://github.com/HHS/simpler-grants-gov/blob/48d93f882c63a711bdec4b16e3150d1293cdff43/api/src/form_schema/forms/budget_narrative_attachment/1/0/form_json.py . Paths, attachment UUID transport and source XML targets are compared with this revision; tests and rule definitions are inventoried separately.

Source PDF was rendered and reviewed along with DAT labels, help, business rules and XSD structure. Instructions are carried on a nonempty section so they remain visible in the current form-plan view.
The spec_id links the maintained TypeSpec definition and layout. Authored examples now live in TypeSpec; the Data tab shows actual preview answers. Source-shaped XSD models are checked independently.

Attachment controls use a library-only UUID reference editor through the existing renderer registry. They preserve application ID transport and never upload files or claim content, existence or ownership verification.

Attachment XML export is not enabled: file metadata resolution and source-only wrappers require the shared XML mapping work. No incomplete UUID-as-file transform is emitted; this is a definition/preview PR, not a submission-ready migration.
risks: Synthetic UUID examples are shape illustrations only. Actual uploads, existence/ownership checks, file constraints, XML attachment metadata, application context and submission behavior remain service/runtime obligations. Do not replace UUIDs with invented file descriptors.
